t: Titan TTB1361MSW 210mm compound mitre saw delivers precise cross, bevel and mitre cuts in timber. The corded tool is suitable for joiners and kitchen fitters working on site or in workshops. Extendable side supports stabilise longer workpieces to improve cutting accuracy, while the lightweight aluminium base ensures durability and easy transportation. Spindle lock allows quick blade changes, and the mechanical brake ensures user safety. Supplied with a TCT wood blade, it delivers clean, reliable cuts across a range of timber. Equipped with a carry handle.
